events.title: TERAFORMR
events.text: TerraformЯ 0.5.0: a claymation sandbox set in the Cordilleras. Step through the BLUEFACE door, stand on a cliff above an endless ocean and throw one penny into the abyss. That penny starts the world's economy and story. Explore · mine · craft · build · survive. Play free in your browser at rizal.info.

events.title: BOTLATCH · RGENERATOR mint tracker
events.text: BOTLATCH tracks every token minted across the lab: AI heart calls, bots, NFTs, social posts, data packages and the Ghost Chain, all linked to RGENERATOR. It includes a converter (game points ↔ R credits) and the BOTLATCH buy · sell · trade · swap page for TerraformЯ. Trading is preview-only for now. R credits are local game credit, not money.
